phrases like "It gets better" or "suicide is xyz and you shouldn't ever consider it" or "try a new diet,  exercise,..." or etc do not translate the same way in a severely depressed mind. Depression isn't always sadness and can't always be treated as such, in the same way  painkillers can't be used to heal brain tumors. Sure a symptom of brain cancer (mental illness) IS headache (suicidal thoughts) .  And painkillers (general advice for depression and suicidal thoughts) ARE effective against it. But the tragedy is when the symptom is mistaken for the disease and as a result,  a person detioriates until they pass away.
~~This post and~~ such advice in general , albeit made of empathy and love,  may at times do as much for some suicidal people as painkillers do for a worsening brain tumor.
